description:

Other locations: Primary Location Only

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744212
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Role name and description**


**Lab Design and Delivery Lead \- Lab Manager**


**THE OPPORTUNITY**



Lab design and delivery specialist. Ensures the Lab reflects the production office environment. Designs infrastructure to provide a validation platform for Secure, Print, Lockers, AV, and Spaces and Services.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Own the end\-to\-end design, delivery and operational readiness of a representative enterprise technology lab environment.
* Define lab architecture, connectivity, identity, device\-management, monitoring, security and environmental requirements that align with production patterns.
* Build validation capabilities across Secure, Print, Lockers, AV, and Spaces and Services solutions.
* Establish lab governance, access controls, asset inventory, configuration baselines, change control and safety practices.
* Plan capacity, budget, procurement and vendor activities for lab infrastructure, devices, licenses and support.
* Develop test environments and release\-validation processes for software, firmware, configuration and product changes.
* Coordinate with product owners, engineering, security, network, workplace and operations teams to maintain production relevance.
* Lead incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, documentation and continuous improvement for lab services.
* Guide and prioritize the work of lab technicians and specialist contributors.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience.
* Extensive experience designing and operating enterprise technology labs, test environments or complex AV infrastructure.
* Proven planning, delivery, supplier\-management and technical\-leadership capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication, stakeholder management and risk\-management skills.
* Strong customer orientation with the ability to balance production fidelity, security, cost and delivery priorities.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Enterprise AV systems design, integration and support.
* Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, including deployment, configuration and lifecycle management.
* Azure Administration knowledge aligned to AZ\-104 concepts.
* Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Microsoft Intune and Autopilot provisioning.
* Network fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, SNMP and secure remote access.
* Monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and AV management platforms.
* PowerShell automation for repeatable provisioning, inventory and validation tasks.
* Test planning, configuration management, asset management, technical documentation and change control.

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Azure Automation, Functions, Logic Apps, Microsoft Graph API and Power Automate.
* Power BI for lab utilization, inventory, quality and validation reporting.
* Practical knowledge of secure print, smart lockers, workplace spaces and related building technology.
* AV industry certifications such as CTS or relevant Crestron credentials.
* ServiceNow integration and workflow automation.
* Experience with vendor qualification, procurement, budgeting and facilities coordination.

  


**What we look for**



We’re looking for a hands\-on technical leader who can create a secure, disciplined and production\-representative validation environment while coordinating multiple technology domains and stakeholders.

  


**What we offer**



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on challenging projects and gain access to an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights throughout your career.


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** You’ll have the tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** You’ll gain the insights, coaching and confidence to help build the leadership capabilities the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior CRO
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer**

**Position:** Senior CRO  
**Company:** UGI  
**Department:** CRO Team  
**Job Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** General Manager (GM)

**Job Summary**

UGI is seeking a highly analytical, strategic, and results\-driven Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer (Senior CRO) to lead its Conversion Rate Optimization Team. The role is responsible for improving admission and repayment conversion performance across business operations by identifying conversion opportunities, optimizing sales processes, enhancing customer engagement strategies, and implementing data\-driven improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Develop and implement strategies to improve lead\-to\-admission conversion rates.
* Identify bottlenecks in the customer journey and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor conversion performance across Sales and Repayment teams.
* Analyse customer behaviour and conversion trends.
* Drive continuous optimization initiatives.

**Sales Performance Optimization**

* Monitor sales funnel performance and executive productivity.
* Identify lead leakage and missed opportunities.
* Review follow\-up quality and sales process compliance.
* Support Branch Managers with performance improvement initiatives.

**Repayment Conversion Optimization**

* Monitor repayment follow\-up effectiveness and recovery performance.
* Analyse overdue cases and recommend improvement strategies.
* Coordinate with Finance and Repayment teams to improve collections.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and manage the CRO Team.
* Set KPIs and monitor productivity.
* Conduct daily huddles and weekly reviews.
* Coach CRO Executives on analytics, audits and process improvements.

**Quality Audits \& Performance Reviews**

* Audit sales and repayment processes.
* Review customer interactions and SOP adherence.
* Provide structured feedback and action plans.

**Business Analytics \& Reporting**

* Prepare Daily Conversion Dashboards, Branch Performance Reports, Executive Productivity Reports, Lead Funnel Analysis, Admission \& Repayment Reports, Lost Opportunity Analysis, Weekly Reviews and Monthly MIS.

**Process Improvement**

* Standardize best practices across branches.
* Develop and update SOPs.
* Recommend automation and operational improvements.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Repayment, Marketing, Finance, Operations and Branch Managers to improve business performance.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Commerce, Operations or related field. MBA preferred.

**Experience**

4–6 years in Sales Operations, Conversion Optimization, Customer Success, Business Analytics or Process Improvement, including at least 2 years in a leadership role.

**Required Skills**

**Technical:** CRM Platforms (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent), Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, MIS Reporting, Dashboard Preparation, Data Analysis, Sales Funnel Analysis.

**Leadership:** Team Leadership, Coaching \& Mentoring, Decision Making, Performance Management, Stakeholder Management.

**Core Competencies:** Analytical Thinking, Strategic Planning, Business Acumen, Communication, Attention to Detail, Result Orientation, Adaptability.

Work Location: In person

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

**Customer Services Manager**

Total Compensation including salary, bonus, commission \& benefits: 3\.4L \- 4\.7L per year

  

This position sits at the heart of our growing global organisation, you will be responsible for all aspects of your centre’s performance. We’ll give you the autonomy and resource to manage your centre as though it’s your own business. You will have a wide range of responsibilities including:


* Being responsible for managing anything and everything on site.
* Rising to every challenge and solving problems.
* Giving tours to prospective customers.
* Upselling to existing customers.
* Above all, looking after our customers so well that each becomes a brand ambassador – for you, your team and IWG.
  

**What we can do for you**


You’re reading the right advert if you’re looking for:


* a fun, challenging and rewarding career.
* great induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
* fantastic promotion prospects.
* generous, achievable incentives and sociable hours.
* access to a comprehensive range of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support mental, physical and financial wellbeing.
  

**About you**


Ideally, you’ll have some experience of delivering against targets when leading a small, close\-knit team. You may have run a flexible workspace centre before, or else a store, restaurant or any site with a high degree of customer focus. Alongside your natural sales and commercial skills, what matters most is that you’ve got the right mindset: passion, drive, ownership and resilience.


* **Passion**: looking after our diverse prospects, customers and guests is at the heart of what we do, so you must bring your passion and positivity to work every day.
* **Drive**: your own and your team’s collective drive for success means you’ll only relax once you’ve delivered the results you’re looking for.
* **Resilience**: a relentless focus on business priorities, regardless of any obstacles placed in front of you.

Above all, you’ll be key to ensuring all our customers only ever receive a truly world\-class service.


And your sense of **ownership** means you’ll continuously ensure the quality of service and the workspace are as good as they possibly can be.

  

**About IWG**


With almost 4,000 tech\-enabled, sustainable and inspiring centres across the world, we’re already four times the scale of our nearest competitor – and we’re continuing to grow.


With 80% of the Fortune 500 already among our customers, and plans to expand to 30,000\+ centres over the next decade, we’re uniquely placed to offer the right person exciting career opportunities as we continue pioneering the workspaces of tomorrow.


We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. That’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres.


We’re also proud of reducing commuting\-related carbon emissions by getting workers out of their cars and onto their bikes and their feet. Alongside our investments in advanced buildings, this supports our commitment to be carbon neutral – which we achieved in 2023\.


So don’t hesitate. Apply today – and let’s work together to help millions of people have a great day at work.
